s0086 names 給事中熊浹; 浹 is Jia, so Xiong Shi is a wrong reading and Xiong Jia is the accurate replacement.

s0156 has 侍御呂柟 and 給事中曾烶; 柟 is Nan and 烶 is Ting, so Lü Zhen and Zeng Yan are misreadings and the proposed names restore the Chinese correctly.

s0193 names 秦王樉; 樉 is Shuang, so Prince of Qin Fang misreads the personal name and Shuang is the correct English form.
